summary: Implemented a new centralized category label mapping utility (CATEGORY_LABELS) and began adopting it in some UI components (LiveSuggestionSearchBox, SearchEmptyRecovery). However, the diff does not show comprehensive application across all required UI surfaces (Home page cards, Search Results page, Worker Profile badges, filters), and SearchEmptyRecovery appears to change the value used for navigation in one fallback path (sending display labels instead of stored slugs).

missing_requirements.requirement: Category rendering must be display-only: UI must never render raw slugs; unknown slugs must use a capitalized-words fallback; and URL params/search filters must remain unchanged (original stored values).
missing_requirements.reason: SearchEmptyRecovery builds a fallback list of popular categories using human-readable labels (e.g., "Construction") and then navigates with `search: { category: value }` where `value` is that label, not a stored slug. This violates the requirement that navigation/search params remain unchanged and display-only.

missing_requirements.requirement: Apply the centralized category label mapping helper everywhere category slugs can become user-visible, specifically including Home page category cards, Search Results page titles/labels/headings, Worker Profile badges, live suggestions dropdown, and category/filter UI (chips/buttons/headings).
missing_requirements.reason: Only LiveSuggestionSearchBox and SearchEmptyRecovery are shown updated to use `getCategoryLabel()`. The diff summary does not show any changes to Search Results pages, Worker Profile pages, or filter UI components, and HomePage still imports `getBilingualCategoryLabel` (not the strict mapping helper) with no evidence that category cards were updated to use the new helper.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a new `formatTaxonomyLabel` router utility that detects known categories and routes to `getCategoryLabel`, otherwise uses `displayName`.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only asked for a strict CATEGORY_LABELS mapping and a single helper for categories, applied across UI. It did not request adding a separate general taxonomy formatter utility.

hallucinated_features.description: Expanded `CATEGORY_LABELS` with many additional category keys/aliases beyond the minimum user-provided mappings (e.g., dailyhelpers, supplies, skilledtrades, electronicsappliances, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: The request required the mapping include at minimum the provided slug→label pairs. Adding extra entries was not requested and may undermine the notion of a "strict" mapping depending on interpretation.
